nodes.summary: Let `Γ` be a family of subsets of Baire space `ℕ^ℕ`, closed under preimages by Borel maps `ℕ^ℕ → ℕ^ℕ`, all of whose members are determined. Then every member of `Γ` has the property of Baire (S. Banach and S. Mazur, Problem 43 of the Scottish Book; J. C. Oxtoby, *The Banach–Mazur game and Banach category theorem*, Ann. of Math. Stud. 39 (1957); Moschovakis, *Descriptive Set Theory*, 2nd ed., AMS 2009, 6A.13–6A.16).
nodes.title: Property of Baire from determinacy

nodes.summary: Let `Γ` be a family of subsets of Baire space `ℕ^ℕ`, closed under preimages by Borel maps `ℕ^ℕ → ℕ^ℕ`, all of whose members are determined. Then every member of `Γ` is countable or contains a non-empty perfect set (M. Davis, *Infinite games of perfect information*, Ann. of Math. Stud. 52 (1964); Moschovakis, *Descriptive Set Theory*, 2nd ed., AMS 2009, 6A.10–6A.12; Woodin, *The continuum hypothesis, Part I*,…
nodes.title: Davis's perfect set theorem from determinacy

nodes.summary: Let `Γ` be a family of subsets of Baire space `ℕ^ℕ`, closed under preimages by Borel maps `ℕ^ℕ → ℕ^ℕ`, all of whose members are determined. Then every member of `Γ` is `μ`-measurable for every σ-finite Borel measure `μ` on `ℕ^ℕ` (J. Mycielski and S. Świerczkowski, *On the Lebesgue measurability and the axiom of determinateness*, Fund. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
